reapack.name: ReaSet
reapack.desc: ReaSet — live setlist and lyrics/chords web interface

version.author: David Jorquera (djenttleman)
version.changelog: ReaSet v2.2: unified background bridge, live lyrics/chords carousel, Director/Player mode and reliability improvements.

metadata.description: ReaSet is a REAPER web interface focused on live performance. It manages setlists, controls transport and displays real-time lyrics and chords.

reapack.name: ReaSet Tools
reapack.desc: Optional authoring and diagnostic tools for ReaSet

metadata.description: Optional tools for authoring lyrics/chords items and diagnosing the ReaSet bridge. Lyrics Tapper requires ReaImGui, which the ReaBoot recipe installs with this package.
